title: Technology Sector Update for 11/15/2018: NTES,CSCO,MARK

Technology stocks were rebounding following two days of losses, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding almost 1% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising 1.7%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) NetEase ( NTES ) rose over 10% at one point early Thursday after the Chinese online gaming company reported non-GAAP Q3 net income exceeding Wall Street expectations and authorized a new, $1 billion stock buyback program over the next year beginning Friday, Nov. 16.
In other sector news:
(+) Cisco ( CSCO ) was 3% higher Thursday afternoon after the networking equipment company reported non-GAAP Q1 net income of $0.75 per share, improving on a $0.61 per share adjusted profit during the same quarter last year and beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.03 per share. Revenue rose 8% year-over-year to $13.1 billion, also topping the $12.86 billion analyst mean. Cisco also is expecting Q2 financial results straddling the Street view looking for non-GAAP net income of $0.72 per share.
(-) Remark Holdings ( MARK ) dropped 39% after the artificial intelligence company late Wednesday reported Q3 revenue that trailed an analyst's expectations. Revenue during the three months ended Sept. 30 was unchanged from the same quarter last year at $19.4 million, falling $4.3 million shy of the single analyst call. The company also is projecting Q4 in a range of $19 million to $23 million compared with the single-analyst call expecting $27.13 million.
